investment_theses.thesis: Long Bitcoin / Short US Dollar (via BTC/DXY proxy or BTC outright) through 2026-Q3 on tariff-driven fiscal deterioration and inflation surprise risk.
supporting_signals: White House doubling down on tariff policy despite midterm backlash and business summit warnings (CNBC 2026-05-05)
October CPI beat expectations (+0.4% MoM, core +0.3% MoM), signaling pass-through inflationary risks not yet priced in (CoinDesk)
China-US geopolitical tensions elevated by Huang affair/spy allegations, historically bullish for BTC safe-haven demand
DXY likely to weaken if tariff-induced stagflation narrative gains traction; BTC historically rallies in USD-weakness regimes
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed tightening cycle accelerates if CPI disappoints to upside; risk-off sentiment crushes risk assets including BTC. Trump's tariff commitment could be negotiating theater, reversed if equities tumble hard.
investment_theses.expression: Buy BTC spot (or 3-month BTC call spread, strike $70K/$80K) + Short DXY via inverse ETF or short futures; hedge with short-dated SPY puts if tail risk rises.

investment_theses.thesis: Long Ethereum via ETH/BTC ratio outperformance on institutional stablecoin and tokenization infrastructure adoption accelerating through 2027.
supporting_signals: Goldman Sachs, Citi, and consortium commit $270M to bank-backed stablecoin targeting 2027 launch (CoinDesk, Cointelegraph)
Plume affiliate licensed as broker-dealer to bring US assets onchain; NYSE Ava Labs deal signals mainstream settlement moving to blockchain (CoinDesk, Cointelegraph)
CoinDesk questions 'Will stablecoins survive once banks catch up?' — institutional adoption narrative favors Ethereum L1/L2 dominance
Kalshi CFTC charges loom (2026-09-30 likely), clearing regulatory path for Ethereum-native prediction markets and derivatives
investment_theses.counter_view: Solana or other Layer-1s capture stablecoin and tokenization volume; Ethereum's complexity and gas costs repel institutional on-rampers. Macro downturn crushes alt-L1 valuations more severely than BTC.
investment_theses.expression: Long ETH spot or 6-month call spread ($2500/$3500 strikes); short BTC spot or buy ETH/BTC ratio via options; position size 2-3% of portfolio for conviction allocation.

investment_theses.thesis: Long commodities (gold, via GLD or futures) and short mega-cap growth tech (via QQQ inverse or sector rotation into value/industrials) on tariff-driven inflation and Fed policy divergence through 2026-Q3.
supporting_signals: White House vows to press ahead with tariffs despite midterm backlash and rising cost warnings (CNBC 2026-05-05)
Business executives at Washington summit flagged supply-chain disruption and rising costs; inflation pass-through likely in coming quarters
October CPI surprised to the upside (+0.4% MoM); tariff-induced cost pressures not yet fully reflected in downstream pricing

investment_theses.thesis: Long spot Solana (SOL) and trending alt tokens (TAO, LIT, ZEC) on crypto infrastructure cycle reset post-CFTC/Kalshi regulatory clarity and bank stablecoin competition narrowing altcoin utility premium.
supporting_signals: CFTC imminent charges against Kalshi likely clear regulatory fog by 2026-09-30, reducing legal uncertainty for decentralized derivatives and DeFi protocols
Bank-backed stablecoins target institutional settlement; alts like Solana (lower fees, faster finality) compete for merchant/DEX flow, vs. Ethereum's premium L2 institutional settlement
